services.name: Chinese Archery
services.desc: This is archery as a martial art: shooting while walking, running, lying down, or hiding; tracking moving targets; holding arrows in hand as you fire. We use the traditional thumb draw - rooted in meditation hand positions - instead of the Western finger draw. Classes are taught inside the studio, and all equipment is provided: bows, arrows, thumb ring, and wrist guard. The approach is meditative - self-observation over score-chasing, and a quiet cure for perfectionism. One hour, all ages - adults, kids, and teens drawing bows side by side. It's the easiest way to try the art as a household. Ask about our family discount. Traditional Chinese archery is one of the oldest disciplines we teach

services.name: Chinese Yoga
services.desc: blends traditional practices from the Pa Kua knowledge - harmonizing body, mind, and spirit. It pairs Qi Gong, the 4,000-year-old art of "life energy cultivation," with yogic movement to build lean, flexible muscle, protect against injury, and melt stress. Where standard yoga holds static poses, Chinese yoga keeps you moving - gentle sequences and breath work that oxygenate the blood and speed muscle recovery. It's the perfect balance to the school's external martial arts practice. Chinese yoga is where Qi Gong meets the mat - a practice that blends mindful movement, breath work, and stretching to cultivate flexibility and inner calm. It draws on the same energy principles

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Looking for a summer that's active, social, and a little bit epic? Our Summer Martial Arts Camp in Burbank gives kids two themed weeks of training, games, and friendly competition - all under the guidance of Master Kyle Billingsley. Camp runs 9:00 AM-12:00 PM, Monday through Friday, in our air-conditioned studio near IKEA. Recommended ages are 7-11; if your child is a little older or younger, just give us a call first. Warrior Week is all about traditional skill. Each day is split into three parts - games to warm up, a focused sword class, and an archery class - so kids build real technique while having a blast. services.name: Our Programs
services.desc: Looking for an enriching, structured physical education experience for your homeschooled child? Our homeschool program in Burbank turns Monday mornings into a session of martial arts, sword arts, and traditional archery - far more than a workout. Kids build cardiovascular fitness, strength, flexibility, and coordination while developing the self-discipline, focus, and confidence that carry straight into their academics and daily life. Our homeschool classes run on Monday mornings during the school year (with a summer recess). Students are also welcome to join any of our regular classes Monday through Friday.
